title: crataegus crus-galli var. prunifolia
intro: Crataegus crus-galli var. prunifolia, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing cardiovascular disease risk, improving blood lipid profiles, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese hawthorn are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
